programmeAssignments.instructions: Adjudicate independently without consulting peers. Adhere strictly to the classical Arabic rubric.
Evaluate speech delivery, tone modulation, rhetorical strength and adherence to the 7-minute limit.
Traditional Thuluth and Diwani script standards must be strictly upheld. Assess balance of geometric letters.
Strict adherence to Hafs an Asim reading standard. Ring bell once for hesitation, twice for uncorrected error.
Assess historical fidelity and monologue pacing. Time limit 10 minutes maximum.
Review technical and documentary merits based on ethical storytelling and visual creativity.
Negative marking applies on buzzer round. Official quizmaster rulings are final.

announcements.title: Grand Inaugural Assembly & Delegate Check-In Guidelines
announcements.summary: All participating institution delegations, faculty advisors, and team captains must complete physical badge verification at Cordova Welcome Gate by 08:30 AM.
announcements.content:
The Festival Secretariat cordially announces that the ceremonial registration desk at the Cordova Grand Reception Lobby will open promptly at 07:30 AM on Monday, December 21, 2026.

All 12 institution contingents must present their official authorization letters and digital QR registration confirmations. Student identity credentials and chest badges will be issued simultaneously. Breakfast and delegate welcome refreshments will be served at the Ibn Battuta Dining Pavilion from 08:00 AM.
announcements.author: Festival Secretariat

announcements.title: Official Judge Briefing & Encryption Protocol Conclave
announcements.summary: Mandatory briefing for all 18 appointed academic judges in the Senate Chamber regarding double-entry verification and encrypted PIN rubrics.
announcements.content:
A mandatory technical orientation session for all appointed Adjudicators across Literary, Public Speaking, Fine Arts, and Islamic Heritage panels will be convened at 09:30 AM in the Senate Adjudication Chambers.

Presided over by Chief Adjudicator Dr. Sayyid Munawwar Ali, the session will review the 4-tier rubric evaluation mechanism, double-entry verification checks, and the digital Judge Portal PIN cryptographic locking system.
announcements.author: Academic Board

announcements.title: Team Captains Protocol & Chest Number Verification Desk
announcements.summary: Secretariat announcement for all 12 registered Team Leaders regarding candidate substitutions, timekeeper synchronization, and appeal procedures.
announcements.content:
All official Team Captains and Faculty Mentors are hereby instructed to attend the Captains Advisory Council at 11:00 AM in the Secretariat Conference Room.

Strict adherence to participant chest numbers (C-101 through C-424) is mandatory. Any formal replacement request must be submitted with written endorsement before the 12:00 PM deadline. Uncertified substitutions will incur automatic disqualification.
announcements.author: Festival Secretariat

announcements.title: Junior Arabic Essay (LIT-JR-102) Syllabus & Call Time Update
announcements.summary: Candidates enrolled in Junior Arabic Essay must report to Ibn Khaldun Academic Hall (Stage 03) at 01:30 PM with authorized writing instruments.
announcements.content:
Competitors registered in LIT-JR-102 (Junior Arabic Essay) are instructed that the preliminary writing window begins at 02:00 PM sharp in Ibn Khaldun Hall.

Official stamped parchment sheets will be provided by the secretariat invigilators. Students may bring their own blue or black fountain pens. Reference materials, lexicons, and digital smart devices are strictly prohibited.
announcements.author: Literary Guild Controller

announcements.title: Stage 02 Al-Farabi Hall Acoustic Calibration Adjustment
announcements.summary: Session 04 start time shifted by 15 minutes to 01:15 PM due to high-precision acoustic tuning for classical poetry recitations.
announcements.content:
The Stage Operations Engineering Team has requested a brief 15-minute acoustic calibration buffer at Stage 02 (Al-Farabi Heritage Hall) to optimize dynamic vocal microphones for the classical Munadarah parliamentary debate.

All attendees and student debaters should take note that Stage 02 proceedings will resume at 01:15 PM.
announcements.relatedProgrammeTitle: Thematic Colloquium: Faith, Reason & Global Modernity
announcements.author: Stage Logistics Desk

announcements.title: Official Result Declaration: Junior Arabic Essay Championship
announcements.summary: The Secretariat officially proclaims 1st, 2nd, and 3rd prize honours for LIT-JR-102. Team A secures 30 points, Team B 20 points, Team A 10 points.
announcements.content:
Following comprehensive adjudication and double-entry audit certification, the official results for Junior Arabic Essay (LIT-JR-102) are published:

• First Prize: Ahmad Rayan K. (Chest C-101, Team A) — 96.5 / 100 (+30 Pts)
• Second Prize: Muhammed Sinan T. (Chest C-201, Team B) — 92.0 / 100 (+20 Pts)
• Third Prize: Zayan Kabeer (Chest C-103, Team A) — 88.5 / 100 (+10 Pts)

Official result posters are now accessible on the public Downloads portal and live leaderboard.
announcements.author: Scoring Board

announcements.title: Secretariat Emergency Backup Generator Switch Notice
announcements.summary: Scheduled seamless auxiliary electrical switchover across campus stages at 01:30 PM for 2 minutes. Internal administrative notice only.
announcements.content:
Campus Facility Engineering will conduct a routine auxiliary load switchover for Stage 01 and Stage 03 uninterruptible power systems (UPS) at 01:30 PM.

All administrative servers, network switches, and judging terminals will remain on isolated battery backup. Technical personnel are requested to monitor stage monitors during this interval.
announcements.author: Technical Controller

announcements.title: Championship Trophy Ceremony & Valedictory Seating Order
announcements.summary: Final evening schedule and VIP procession protocol for the Grand Valedictory Conclave at Cordova Grand Stage.
announcements.content:
The Festival Steering Committee has established the official protocol for the closing Valedictory Assembly.

Team delegations will be ushered into designated tiered seating by 03:45 PM. The conferment of the Dalenzia 2K26 Rolling Champions Trophy and individual Gold Medallions will take place under the auspices of Chancellor and honorable guest dignitaries.
